prompt:
A pavement photographed from directly overhead, the camera pointing straight
down, vertical frame, graphic and clean. The picture is split in half down
the middle by the painted edge, which runs from the top of the frame to the
bottom as a straight vertical line through the exact centre. The LEFT HALF,
edge to edge, is a bicycle strip painted a faded dusty brick red, muted and
desaturated, closer to weathered terracotta than to bright red, with one
white bicycle pictogram centred in it. The RIGHT HALF, edge to edge, is grey
pavement slabs. Each half takes the same width as the other. Daylight,
overcast and flat.
